subject: Benchmark report launch — lifecycle email A/B plan (segments + success metrics)
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jun 30, 2025 at 9:12 AM PT
Subject: Benchmark report launch — lifecycle email A/B plan (segments + success metrics)

Team — sharing a proposed A/B plan for the benchmark report launch lifecycle emails. Goal is to drive (1) self-serve signups + activation and (2) qualified demo requests for Dedicated/Private.

Asks for today:
1) Tyler: can you sanity-check segmentation feasibility + list sizes + timing constraints (deliverability / throttling)?
2) Isabelle: confirm attribution + success metric definitions + how we’ll read “influenced pipeline” in HubSpot.
3) Soojin: confirm copy is aligned with claims/disclaimers language (esp. “latency/$”).
4) Grace: confirm CTA + SDR routing for the enterprise segment.

Current proposal (high level)
- Segment A (PLG active): last 30d API usage > 0, no sales owner → CTA: “View interactive benchmark” + “Try model in 5 minutes”.
- Segment B (PLG inactive): signed up, no usage last 30d → CTA: “Get 10k free tokens + see the fastest regions”.
- Segment C (enterprise leads): known company email, job function Eng/ML/Platform, or existing HubSpot Lead Status ≠ Disqualified → CTA: “Get a Dedicated sizing consult” + “Talk to Solutions”.

A/B tests (subject + hero framing)
- A: Subject leans technical/transparent. B: Subject leans outcome/cost.
- Variant 1 hero: “Latency per dollar (p50/p95 + $/1M tokens)”
- Variant 2 hero: “Production inference economics across regions”

Success metrics (draft)
- Primary: click-to-activation (signup → first API request within 7d) for Seg A/B; demo request submission rate for Seg C.
- Secondary: CTR, benchmark page engagement, export clicks, and “Contact sales” click.

Attachments:
- launch-email-copy-v1.docx (draft copy w/ placeholders)
- benchmark_launch_email_ab_test_plan_v1.xlsx (segments, splits, metrics)

Ben
—
Ben Carter
Growth Campaign Lead
Redwood Inference


From: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jun 30, 2025 at 10:01 AM PT
Subject: Re: Benchmark report launch — lifecycle email A/B plan (segments + success metrics)

Feasible, with a couple constraints:

Segmentation/list sizes (rough, as of this morning):
- Seg A (PLG active 30d): ~18.4k contacts (email-able). 
- Seg B (PLG inactive 30d): ~41.2k contacts (email-able).
- Seg C (enterprise leads): ~6.1k contacts (email-able).

Notes:
- We should exclude anyone who received the “June product update” within last 72h to reduce complaint rate (I can add suppression list).
- Throttling: recommend send windows staggered across 2–3 hours (we saw slight Gmail temp deferrals last time with large sends).
- A/B: keep it to 2 subject lines + 2 body variants max, otherwise the cells get too small for Seg C.

Instrumentation:
- UTMs: I’ll standardize: utm_campaign=benchmark-report-launch-2025, utm_source=lifecycle, utm_medium=email, utm_content={segment}_{variant}.
- HubSpot campaign tagging: INT-9322 is in progress; we can still launch if we rely on UTMs + hidden form field on demo request.

If you’re good with it, I’ll create the workflows today + schedule for launch week.

Tyler

From: Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jun 30, 2025 at 11:09 AM PT
Subject: Re: Benchmark report launch — lifecycle email A/B plan (segments + success metrics)

Metric defs (proposal, aligned w/ our dashboard spec):

Seg A/B (self-serve)
- Primary conversion: “Activated” = API key created + first successful completion request (2xx) within 7 days of email click. (If we can’t reliably join click → auth, we can fall back to signup timestamp + first request.)
- Secondary: time-to-first-request (median), and “returning usage” (any usage in days 8–14).

Seg C (enterprise)
- Primary conversion: demo request form submit (or /contact-sales submit) attributed to email click within 14 days.
- Secondary: meeting booked within 21 days.

Influenced pipeline (guardrails)
- We should report influenced pipeline as: HubSpot deals created within 30 days where primary contact had an email click OR visited benchmark landing page with utm_campaign=benchmark-report-launch-2025.
- Call it “influenced” (not “sourced”) unless last-touch is lifecycle email.

One caveat: the interactive benchmark page will drive a ton of “view content” events. We should avoid over-reading those; keep the KPI hierarchy strict.

If helpful, I can add a one-pager in the dashboard doc on: attribution windows + priority rules (email click > page view > direct).

Isabelle


From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jun 30, 2025 at 12:02 PM PT
Subject: Re: Benchmark report launch — lifecycle email A/B plan (segments + success metrics)

Copy notes from PMM/legal alignment (prelim — final language after Michael/Sofia sign-off):

1) Subject lines: avoid absolute “fastest” / “best” phrasing. Prefer “See latency/$ across regions” vs “We’re #1 in latency/$”.
2) Make sure we use the label consistently: “latency per dollar (latency/$)” and add the tool-tip style disclaimer sentence in body (short form).
3) CTA should link to the landing page section that includes the methodology summary + “How we measured” anchor. (We want people to see the caveats before they screenshot charts.)

I reviewed the attachment quickly. Suggested edits to incorporate in v1:
- Replace “the fastest regions” → “compare regions by latency/$ and tail latency”.
- Add one line: “Results vary by workload; see methodology and configs.”

Also: for Seg B (inactive), I’d avoid “10k free tokens” unless we’re certain we can honor it during launch week traffic. Can we phrase as “free credits” without a number, or confirm the number w/ Finance?

Soojin


From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jun 30, 2025 at 1:18 PM PT
Subject: Re: Benchmark report launch — lifecycle email A/B plan (segments + success metrics)

For Seg C, +1 to a very explicit CTA.

Routing suggestion:
- CTA button: “Get a Dedicated sizing consult” → goes to contact sales form with hidden fields: campaign=benchmark-report-launch-2025, intent=dedicated_sizing.
- Secondary link: “Need Private/VPC?” → same form with intent=private_vpc.

If we can tag intent, SDRs can route to the right playbook immediately (Dedicated sizing vs Security/Private discovery). Stephanie can help align on SLA for follow-up.

Also recommend we add a one-liner in the enterprise email footer:
“Looking to replicate these numbers? We can share the workload profile and help run a proof-of-concept in your regions.”

Grace


From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jun 30, 2025 at 2:07 PM PT
Subject: Re: Benchmark report launch — lifecycle email A/B plan (segments + success metrics)

This is great — thanks all.

Decisions / next steps:
- Tyler: proceed with 2x2 only (2 subject lines x 2 body heroes). Stagger sends + suppression list (June update within 72h). Please draft workflows + send me screenshots for final review.
- Isabelle: adopt your metric defs + attribution windows. Please add the “influenced vs sourced” note into the dashboard spec so we don’t drift.
- Soojin: I’ll swap “fastest” language + add the short disclaimer line + methodology anchor. Re: credits — I’ll change to “free credits” for now and we can add a number later if Finance confirms.
- Grace: we’ll implement intent tagging on the contact sales form (Dedicated sizing vs Private/VPC).

Re: timing — can we target:
- Seg C on launch morning (8:30am local)
- Seg A/B later same day (10:30am local)

I’ll send updated copy as launch-email-copy-v2 end of day.

Ben


From: Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Benchmark report launch — lifecycle email A/B plan (segments + success metrics)

Yep on timing.

One more ops note: for “local time” scheduling, HubSpot splits are a bit coarse. We can do US + EMEA separate sends (APAC optional). If we only do one send, we’ll bias toward US morning.

Proposed send plan:
- Enterprise (Seg C): US 8:30am PT / EMEA 9:00am CET (separate workflows)
- PLG active + inactive (Seg A/B): US 10:30am PT / EMEA 11:00am CET

I’ll set this up and drop the workflow links in PM-812.

Tyler
